officialApp.name: Lightspeed Aviation App
officialApp.notes: Free iPad/iPhone in-flight cockpit recording app. Connects over Bluetooth to record incoming and outgoing communications, play back transmissions, draw diagrams and archive flights. It is a flight-recording/training app, not a settings or battery app.

battery.chargingIndicators: Battery indicator LED on the control module. Lightspeed does not publish percentage steps or the exact low-battery thresholds.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: two AA batteries (3 V). No charging case. Panel-powered 6-pin LEMO variants run from aircraft power with AA backup. Lightspeed does not publish a runtime figure on the Zulu 4 product page.

anc.notes: Aviation ANR optimized for deep, broad low-frequency cockpit noise, not consumer ANC. No transparency mode. Passive attenuation remains when switched off.

features.name: Aviation active noise reduction
features.notes: Single ANR on/off; no level selection.

features.name: Dual Bluetooth
features.notes: Two devices connected simultaneously; A2DP music/calls plus aviation-app alerts.

features.name: ComPriority
features.notes: Automatically lowers auxiliary/Bluetooth audio during radio or intercom transmissions, then softly restores it.

features.name: Auxiliary audio input
features.notes: Integrated control-box auxiliary input for a phone or music player.

features.name: In-flight communications recording
features.notes: Lightspeed Aviation App records over Bluetooth; iOS only.

officialApp.name: Lightspeed App
officialApp.notes: iOS-only app for HearingEQity hearing profile, CO sensor data/thresholds, recording and firmware updates. The app is not required to fly; Android users need an iOS device only for first-time setup. The app does not show a battery percentage.

battery.chargingIndicators: No dedicated charging LED is documented; a published user review specifically complains that plugging in the UAC charging cable gives no charge indication.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery with two interchangeable magazines: a rechargeable lithium-ion cartridge or a two-AA cartridge. No charging case. The Li-ion magazine charges in the headset over UAC/USB; an optional external charger exists.

anc.notes: Aviation ANR, not consumer ANC. HearingEQity builds a 12-frequency hearing profile and applies personalized equalization; it is not personalized noise cancellation. Rotax profile is selected in the app.

features.name: Aviation active noise reduction
features.notes: Signature and Rotax-specific profiles; profile switching is app-controlled.

features.name: Kanari carbon-monoxide sensor
features.notes: Always-on cabin CO monitoring with audible/visual alerts; thresholds and history in the app.

features.name: HearingEQity personalized audio
features.notes: 12-frequency hearing test in the app creates a profile stored in the headset.

features.name: Bluetooth calls and audio

features.name: Auxiliary audio via UAC

controls.notes: App configures hearing profile, CO thresholds and ANR profile, but not button behaviour.

audio.notes: 12-frequency hearing test drives a personalized equalization curve. Bluetooth A2DP. Codec list and multipoint support are not published. 40 mm moving-coil transducer, 20 Hz–20 kHz.

officialApp.name: FlightLink
officialApp.notes: Lightspeed's warranty/registration page lists Tango as FlightLink-compatible. FlightLink is a cockpit recording app, not a battery or settings app.

battery.chargingIndicators: Not documented in the sell sheet; the headset is rechargeable and has no charging case.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: built-in 3.7 V rechargeable lithium-ion. This is the first Lightspeed aviation headset with a rechargeable Li-ion pack instead of AA cells. No case. The headset is wireless via the Lightspeed Link panel interface, with a wired backup cable.

anc.notes: Aviation ANR; ANR maximum SPL greater than 120 dB at 100 Hz per the sell sheet. Not consumer ANC; no transparency mode.

features.name: Bluetooth calls and stereo audio
features.notes: Bluetooth phone and A2DP audio.

features.name: Lightspeed Link wireless cockpit link
features.notes: Proprietary wireless link through a panel interface; not Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. Up to six Tango headsets can operate in one aircraft.

features.name: ComPriority
features.notes: Volume and ComPriority controls are on the headset, not a control box.

features.name: Wired backup/auxiliary connection
features.notes: Backup cable allows wired operation.

features.name: Aircraft intercom and radio communications
features.notes: Panel interface routes communications to the wireless headset.

features.name: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery
features.notes: 3.7 V; charged from the panel interface or charger.

controls.physicalButtons: Headset-mounted controls for power, volume, ComPriority and Bluetooth; no inline control box.
controls.notes: Lightspeed positions the key controls on the headset itself to preserve the wireless design.

audio.notes: 40 mm moving-coil headphone, 20 Hz–20 kHz. Bluetooth phone and A2DP. Codec list not published.

featureDeltaFromPrevious: First premium aviation headset with no cable to the aircraft.
First Lightspeed aviation headset powered by a rechargeable lithium-ion battery.
Lightspeed Link proprietary wireless link, up to six headsets per aircraft.
